args.title: Combined summary: Tamarack warehouse automation (2026) + companion piece
args.body:
- Warehouse automation in 2026: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.

Sources:
- https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse
- https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion
